title: Delete the dead duplicate auth_validators.dart under features/account/onboarding
why: lib/features/account/onboarding/domain/validators/auth_validators.dart is byte-identical (`diff` clean) to lib/features/onboarding/domain/validators/auth_validators.dart, and defines the same public top-level functions (validateEmail, validatePassword, validateDisplayName). A repo-wide grep found zero importers of the features/account copy inside lib/ or test/ — only the features/onboarding copy is actually imported (by signup_screen.dart, sign_in_screen.dart, and 2 tests). Yet account.dart's public barrel re-exports the dead copy as part of the feature's advertised public surface, so any external caller who imports it via the barrel gets a function that is NOT the one this feature's own screens actually use, and a future fix to one copy (e.g. the password-length policy) will silently not apply to the other.
recommendation: Delete lib/features/account/onboarding/domain/validators/auth_validators.dart and its account.dart export line. If validators genuinely need to be shared across features/account and features/onboarding, give them one owning location and have the other import via that feature's barrel.
acceptance_criteria: File removed; account.dart no longer exports it; flutter analyze / build stays green
AG-4 duplicate-symbol grep across lib/ no longer flags validateEmail/validatePassword/validateDisplayName twice
mergedFrom: Delete or consolidate the orphaned duplicate features/account/onboarding/domain/validators/auth_validators.dart
Rename one of the two generated authStateProvider symbols to remove the name clash
